data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-5: an integration test exercises the equivalence test in a configuration-isolated environment (empty HOME, no pre-existing worktrees, no global git config, no pre-set developer env vars) and passes

## Description
Create tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence-isolated.sh: sources the SHARED tests/lib/config-isolation.sh helper (task-1), invokes config_isolation_setup, runs the full tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh (task-2) inside the isolated scope, asserts it exits 0, then config_isolation_teardown. Discovered by validate.sh's tests/runners/ scan (wired in task-2). chmod +x.

## TDD Test Approach
Given the shared config-isolation helper + the equivalence test; When this test sources config-isolation.sh, enters the isolated scope (empty HOME, no worktrees, /dev/null global git config, unset DSO_*/GIT_*), and runs test-runner-equivalence.sh inside it; Then the equivalence test exits 0 under isolation, proving it does not depend on developer-local config.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] test exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence-isolated.sh
- [ ] sources the SHARED config-isolation helper (single implementation)
  Verify: grep -Eq 'tests/lib/config-isolation\.sh' tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence-isolated.sh
- [ ] invokes the full equivalence test under isolation
  Verify: grep -Eq 'test-runner-equivalence\.sh' tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence-isolated.sh
- [ ] runs under isolation exits 0 [dd-5]
  Verify: bash tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence-isolated.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Create config-isolated integration test that runs the equivalence test under empty HOME / no worktrees / no global git config
